lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She's escalating. More hazards, tighter corridors. She does this when she's losing control of a situation.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I designed every system in this facility. The layout, the sentinels, the hazards. All of it interconnected. All of it mine.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: You are the only variable I have not yet accounted for.
